intro.heading: I build custom websites that are clear and easy to use
intro.tagline: No unnecessary stuff. Every website is unique, I can take inspiration from what you like and adapt it to your needs
intro.servicesOverview: I build websites tailored to each case: from simple pages to interactive projects with forms, search features, dynamic content, or even text-only websites. Whatever you need can be planned and built.
intro.hostingNote: I can handle domain and hosting if you want to avoid the technical side, or leave everything in your hands. I can also maintain the website monthly or deliver everything (code, domain, and hosting) so it’s fully yours with no dependency.

pricing.title: About pricing:
pricing.description: Every project is different. I usually stay below market price because I prioritize the experience and building things properly over inflating budgets. Depending on your needs, we adjust everything with no commitment.

about.title: Who’s behind this
about.intro: My name is Héctor Jarque. I didn’t come from an agency or a typical bootcamp path. I started from scratch building projects on my own, breaking things and learning until I truly understood how websites work.
about.location: I live in Valencia. I work remotely without any issue, and if you’re nearby we can grab a coffee.
about.learning: I started with zero knowledge and slowly built projects until I could develop full websites and understand what’s behind every part of them.
about.honesty: No fluff. If something can’t be done, I’ll tell you. If it can be done but it’s not a good idea, I’ll explain why.
